Package com.bilt.pos.receipt

Class ReceiptHelper

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.receipt.ReceiptHelper
public final class ReceiptHelper extends Object
Utility class for serializing and deserializing ReceiptType objects to/from XML and Base64-encoded XML strings.

Receipt XML payloads conform to the urn:bilt:receipt:v1 schema and are carried inside OutputContent.OutputXHTML fields of Nexo PaymentReceipt objects.

Example usage: 


 // Parse a receipt from Base64 (as received in OutputXHTML)
 ReceiptType receipt = ReceiptHelper.fromBase64(outputXhtml);
 String plainText = receipt.getPlainTextReceipt();
 String html = ReceiptHelper.htmlAsString(receipt);

 // Serialize a receipt to XML
 String xml = ReceiptHelper.toXml(receipt);

    • fromBase64

      public static ReceiptType fromBase64(String base64) throws jakarta.xml.bind.JAXBException
      Deserializes a ReceiptType from a Base64-encoded XML string.

      Some terminals put the receipt XML into OutputXHTML raw, skipping the Base64 encoding the schema calls for. A payload opening with '<' cannot be Base64 ('<' is outside the alphabet), so it is unambiguously the raw form and parsed as XML directly.

      Parameters:
      base64 - the Base64-encoded (or raw) XML string, as found in OutputXHTML
      Returns:
      the deserialized receipt
      Throws:
      jakarta.xml.bind.JAXBException - if deserialization fails

    • htmlAsString

      public static String htmlAsString(ReceiptType receipt)
      Returns the HTML receipt content as a String, or null if not present.

      The schema stores HTML as xs:base64Binary, so JAXB represents it as byte[]. This convenience method decodes it to a UTF-8 string.

      Parameters:
      receipt - the receipt
      Returns:
      the HTML receipt as a string, or null
